basis: Original immutable funded system decisions; original stakes/odds; no account verification or operating costs.
interval_method: 10000 whole-game bootstrap resamples, fixed seed 362026, percentile 95%; correlated selections retained in each game block.

calibration.basis: Frozen original p/(1-push), win/loss only; one observation per contract; game clustering is reported, not proof of independence or profitability.

resolution_audit.source_reverification: Not performed by this report; retained evidence and contract arithmetic are checked without asserting account verification.
